CREATE TABLE `instrument_collection_requests_v4` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `trading_account_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `symbol` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `request_bucket` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','running','succeeded','failed') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `attempts` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `lease_token` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `lease_expires_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_revision` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_code` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `requested_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `completed_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_instrument_request_scope` (`user_id`,`trading_account_id`,`symbol`,`request_bucket`),
  KEY `idx_instrument_request_recovery` (`status`,`lease_expires_at_utc`,`id`),
  KEY `fk_instrument_request_account` (`trading_account_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_instrument_request_account` FOREIGN KEY (`trading_account_id`) REFERENCES `trading_accounts` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_instrument_request_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_instrument_request_completion` CHECK ((((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'running')) and (`completed_at_utc` is null) and (`result_revision` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'succeeded') and (`completed_at_utc` is not null) and (`result_revision` is not null) and (`result_revision` > 0)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'failed') and (`completed_at_utc` is not null) and (`result_revision` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_instrument_request_lease` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'running') and (`lease_token` is not null) and (`lease_expires_at_utc` is not null)) or ((`status` <> _utf8mb4'running') and (`lease_token` is null) and (`lease_expires_at_utc` is null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
